classification.difficultyReason: Combine three population groups and subtract their total from the whole population.

content.prompt: In 1898, the population of the German Empire was $45\,234\,061$. If $28\,318\,592$ were Lutherans, $124\,567$ belonged to other protestant denominations, $561\,612$ were Jewish and the remainder Roman Catholic, how many Roman Catholics were there?

answer.worked:
Population in the three named groups:

$$\begin{array}{r}28\,318\,592\\124\,567\\+\;561\,612\\\hline29\,004\,771\end{array}$$

Roman Catholic population:

$$\begin{array}{r}45\,234\,061\\-\;29\,004\,771\\\hline16\,229\,290\end{array}$$

There were $16\,229\,290$ Roman Catholics.

Check: $29\,004\,771+16\,229\,290=45\,234\,061$.
